restrictions.description: Significant surge in planning, development, and construction of data centers and battery energy storage facilities nationally and in Georgia; the county's zoning ordinance (from the 1990s) did not contemplate these uses. Active/extended as of 2026-09-23; on 2026-08-04 the Board of Commissioners approved (7-0) a third 100-day moratorium on data center permits, running to about 2026-11-12, while a draft ordinance covering data centers, solar farms and battery storage (reviewed at the July 30 work session) moves toward Planning and Zoning hearings; the board expected to review the ordinance at its December meeting. Legal basis: Carroll County Board of Commissioners resolution adopted March 3, 2026, applicable only to unincorporated Carroll County; extension resolution adopted June 3, 2026.
